page.title: Help center
page.subtitle: How to use Fresh Start to prepare your bankruptcy consultation, what the platform does, and what always stays with an attorney.
page.searchHint: Open a section to see the questions it contains.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.a1: A preparation workspace. It organizes your financial information (income, expenses, debts, assets and evidence) and prepares questions for a professional consultation. It is not a law firm, it does not file cases, and it does not provide legal advice.
gettingStarted.a2: From Home, create your request. From there the case file moves through stages: household, income, expenses, debts, assets, documents and review. You can leave and come back — whatever you captured is saved.
gettingStarted.q3: Do I have to complete everything in one sitting?
gettingStarted.a3: No. The progress indicator shows how much information is still missing, and the next-action card takes you straight to the most useful next step.

documents.title: Managing documents
documents.q1: How do I register a document?
documents.a1: In the Documents stage, use Add evidence. Give the document a type, a name and a status.
documents.a2: Not in this demo. What is recorded is the document's record (type, name, status and notes), not the file itself. Real file upload belongs to a later phase of the project.
documents.a3: Requested: the attorney asked for it and it has not arrived. Received: it is registered. Reviewed: the attorney has reviewed it.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.q1: Where do my tasks come from?
tasks.a1: From two places: the gaps the case review detects, and the documents the attorney explicitly requests.
tasks.a2: The Tasks entry in the menu opens the review stage of the case file, with the checklist and everything still outstanding before you submit.
tasks.q3: Can I submit the case file with tasks outstanding?
tasks.a3: Yes, but the review will point out what is missing. The more complete it arrives, the more useful the consultation.

activities.title: Activity
activities.a1: The case file timeline: when it was created, which stages were completed, when it was sent to the attorney and what came back.
activities.q2: Is there activity across several cases?
activities.a2: Not yet. The timeline is per case file. For attorneys, a cross-case activity view does not exist yet and appears disabled in the menu rather than leading to an empty screen.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.a1: Answer questions about your case file: what is missing, which document backs a figure, or how your monthly balance looks. It works only with the context of the case you have access to.
assistant.q2: Can it tell me whether chapter 7 or 13 suits me?
assistant.a2: No. The platform does not determine eligibility or select a chapter: that is a legal conclusion and belongs to an attorney. The assistant can help you prepare the question, not answer it.
assistant.q3: What happens if the model is unavailable?
assistant.a3: The assistant falls back to deterministic, rule-based guidance and tells you so. It would rather answer less than invent.

account.title: Account and preferences
account.q1: How do I change the language?
account.a1: With the language button in the header. It switches directly between Spanish and English and translates the whole interface immediately.
account.q2: What does 'Remember me on this device' do?
account.a2: It keeps your session open when you come back. Do not enable it on a shared computer.
account.a3: No. They are public and shared by every visitor. Never enter real personal or financial information.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does Fresh Start file my case with the court?
faq.a1: No. It prepares and organizes the information; filing belongs to an attorney.
faq.q2: Does it run the official means test?
faq.a2: No. The calculations you see are there to guide the conversation with your attorney, not as an official determination.
faq.a3: In this demo every name, case and figure is synthetic.
faq.q4: What happens when I submit the case file?
faq.a4: It moves to attorney review. You can follow the status in the case activity and respond to any documents you are asked for.
